prompt: A knight in polished silver plate armor and a white tabard, side profile facing east, caught mid-vanish: the rear half of his body has dissolved into a swirl of bright white-gold motes and wispy cloud, while the front half is still solid. An enemy axe-blade swings through the empty air where his torso just was, striking nothing. The background is a dim stone battlefield at dawn, soft pale-gold light. White flicker magic.

A white-robed cleric re-materializing, stepping forward out of a billowing cloud of luminous white-gold light, her body half-formed of glowing particles coalescing back into solid flesh and cloth, hands raised. The only source of light is the radiant cloud she is emerging from. The background is a shadowed cathedral interior with tall arches in deep blue-grey.

Low upward camera angle looking steeply up at a soldier in bronze and white armor whose body is dissolving upward into a column of swirling white cloud and shimmering golden sparks, his upraised arm already turned to luminous mist. The background is pale dawn sky with crepuscular rays. White flicker magic, awe from below.

A white pegasus with feathered wings winking out of existence, its hindquarters and tail already burst into a soft puff of white cloud and drifting feathers and golden glitter, its head and forelegs still solid, rearing. The background is a high green clifftop under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. White vanishing magic.

A solid armored knight in white and silver stands rigid facing south, and a translucent ghostly afterimage of the same knight is offset just to his left, made of faint white-gold light, as though he is flickering between two positions at once. The background is a torchlit fortress courtyard at night, warm orange torches against deep blue shadow.

Close-up of an armored warrior in white and silver plate, three-quarter view, the entire lower half of his body from the waist down already dissolved into a churning cloud of white vapor and golden sparks, the upper body still solid and looking down at his own vanishing legs in alarm. The background is a dark muddy battlefield trench, dim grey-blue light. White flicker magic.

A spear thrust by an enemy passes clean through the empty space where a white-armored knight stood, the knight now reduced to a fading outline of white-gold sparkles and thin cloud being carried off on the wind, the spear striking nothing. Wide shot. The background is a grassy green field at dusk under a violet sky. White vanishing magic dodging the blow.

A radiant winged angel in white robes and gleaming gold-trimmed armor materializing on a stone parapet at dawn, her body and wings forming out of a swirl of luminous white cloud and golden light, edges still half-dissolved into glowing mist, hovering just above the stone. The background is a castle battlement against a soft pink-gold dawn sky. White flicker magic.

Tight close-up of a knight in silver plate gauntlet and white sleeve, his forearm and shield-hand dissolving into a fine spray of white-gold sparkles and thin wisps of cloud as a curved enemy sword slices straight through the shimmering empty space, cutting nothing. The background is a blurred dark grey dungeon wall. White vanishing magic, the limb turning to light.

A foot-soldier in a clean white tabard and burnished steel breastplate standing in side profile facing east, his body cleanly splitting apart into drifting white cloud and bright silver-white light from one side to the other, half solid armored man and half luminous vapor scattering into the air. The background is a deep teal-blue twilight sky, clean and dark for contrast. White flicker magic.
